'''Gree''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] drunken [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that frequented the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. One time in [[3645 BBY]], he met the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rojo Trace]] who was searching for [[Hestizo Trace|his sister]].
